clause: Path-topology commands: offset / simplify / outline-stroke / join-average [STU-VEC-006]

scope.summary: Implement the non-destructive path-topology commands as first-class typed contracts identical for operator + model: offset path (numeric inset/outset with join-style corner handling), simplify (adjustable-strength anchor reduction approximating the source curve), outline stroke (convert stroked path to filled geometry matching weight/align/caps/joins/dashes), and join/average (join open endpoints + average anchor positions on one or both axes).
expected_tests: test: offset/simplify/outline-stroke/join-average produce deterministic geometry; outline-stroke matches rendered weight

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: No path-topology ops; core illustration editing missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
SQLite creep on a studio_* write path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
